name: Philippines

nationalGame.name: Arnis
nationalGame.about: Arnis, the art of stick fighting, is the Philippines' official national martial art and sport.

loved.name: Basketball
loved.why: Courts sit on streets, beaches and rooftops — the PBA league began back in 1975.

loved.name: Boxing
loved.why: Manny Pacquiao is a national hero.

loved.name: Sepak Takraw
loved.why: Flying kicks over the net — Filipino teams are strong.

fact: Almost every town fiesta in the Philippines includes a basketball tournament — the whole barangay turns up.
